gst_concession.statutory_authority: Ministry of Finance Notification No. 14/2019-Central Tax (Rate) & MoHI Guidelines
gst_concession.required_certification: UDID (Unique Disability ID) Card or State Medical Board Certificate showing 40% or higher physical disability

Delhi.statutory_rule: Delhi Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 13
Delhi.conditions: Adapted vehicle owned and driven by or used for person with >= 40% physical disability.

Maharashtra.statutory_rule: Maharashtra Motor Vehicles Tax Act, Section 13(1)
Maharashtra.conditions: Invalid carriage / adapted vehicle specially constructed/adapted for Divyangjan.

Karnataka.statutory_rule: Karnataka Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 16
Karnataka.conditions: Complete exemption from lifetime motor vehicle tax for adapted vehicles.

Tamil Nadu.statutory_rule: Tamil Nadu Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 13
Tamil Nadu.conditions: 100% tax exemption for adapted motor vehicles with valid RTO endorsement.

Uttar Pradesh.statutory_rule: UP Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 14
Uttar Pradesh.conditions: Zero road tax for adapted vehicles registered in the name of person with benchmark disability.

Gujarat.statutory_rule: Gujarat Motor Vehicles Tax Act, Section 13
Gujarat.conditions: Full exemption on one personal adapted vehicle per person with benchmark disability.

Haryana.statutory_rule: Haryana Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 15
Haryana.conditions: 100% exemption on road tax for adapted passenger cars.

Kerala.statutory_rule: Kerala Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 22
Kerala.conditions: Full exemption from one-time road tax for adapted vehicles.

West Bengal.statutory_rule: West Bengal Motor Vehicles Tax Act, Section 13
West Bengal.conditions: Exemption granted for invalid carriages and modified adapted vehicles.

Telangana.statutory_rule: Telangana Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, Section 9
Telangana.conditions: Life tax exemption for motor vehicles specially adapted for differently-abled citizens.

toll_exemption.statutory_rule: Rule 11, National Highways Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) Rules, 2008 & NHAI Guidelines
toll_exemption.eligibility: Mechanical vehicles specially designed and constructed, or adapted, for the use of persons suffering from physical defect or disability.
toll_exemption.procedure: Apply for Divyangjan Exemption FASTag via IHMCL/NHAI portal submitting RC with 'Adapted Vehicle' endorsement and UDID.

alteration_immunity.statutory_basis: Proviso to Section 52(1), Motor Vehicles Act 1988
alteration_immunity.protection: Explicit statutory exemption from the general prohibition on vehicle modification.
alteration_immunity.details: Under Section 52(1) proviso, alterations to a motor vehicle to facilitate its use as an adapted vehicle by a person with disability are strictly permitted and cannot be penalised under Section 182A(4) (illegal modification penalty up to Rs 1,00,000 / 1 year imprisonment).

checklist: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card with >= 40% locomotor disability
Certificate from Ministry of Heavy Industries (MoHI) for 18% GST concession (applied online via dhi.nic.in)
RTO Form 20 / Form 26 with 'Adapted Vehicle' category endorsement on RC
Authorized retrofitment test certificate from ARAI/ICAT approved kit installer (if modified post-factory)
IHMCL Exemption FASTag application for 100% toll fee waiver on National Highways
